title: Bird Species Diversity by Week
dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), bird-feeder detections (`birdfeeder:detection`), doorbell/package events (`doorbell:event`).
app: Pet GPS/activity trackers (Tractive/Fi/Whistle), smart feeders and litter boxes, bird feeders/cams, and home-life sensors via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=birdfeeder:detection
| bin _time span=1w
| stats dc(species) as species_count, count as visits by feeder _time
| sort - species_count
description: Summarises how many distinct species visited each week, turning a fun bird camera feed into a lightweight biodiversity tracker.
value: This adds a little delight to the dataset while also helping you notice seasonal change or the impact of feeder location.
implementation: Forward bird-feeder detections with species labels; review weekly species counts and compare them across seasons.
visualization: Weekly chart of species diversity and visit volume.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how many different kinds of birds showed up at your feeder each week.
